title: Escape from New York Remake Faces Conflicting Snyder and Rodriguez Reports
excerpt:
John Carpenter's comments have fueled speculation about a director change.
Neither a replacement nor a production schedule is confirmed.
body_md:
The long-discussed remake of Escape from New York is facing another round of uncertainty. Reports suggest Zack Snyder may no longer be attached and Robert Rodriguez could be considered as a replacement.

The speculation stems from an interview with original filmmaker John Carpenter. His ambiguous remarks about Snyder were interpreted by some outlets as a departure from the project. Other listeners argue that the comment referred to Snyder's wider career rather than this particular remake.

The project has passed through several potential creative teams over the years without reaching stable production. Snyder's definitive exit, Rodriguez's formal appointment and any production or release timetable remain unconfirmed.
